name: Elias
role: Heavenly messenger named in several revelations
dateNote: Section 110 says Elias appeared to Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery in the Kirtland Temple on 3 April 1836.
importance: Section 27 says Elias holds the keys to restore all things and visited Zacharias, father of John the Baptist. Section 77 uses the name for one sent to gather Israel and restore all things. Section 110 says Elias appeared in the Kirtland Temple and committed “the dispensation of the gospel of Abraham”. Section 138 names an Elias who was with Moses on the Mount of Transfiguration.
connections: The revelations list him with Moroni, Elijah, Moses, and John the Baptist. The D&C does not say plainly whether every use of the name means the same person.

sources.title: Doctrine and Covenants 110 (official text and heading)

reviewNote: Described only as the text presents him. Checked 27:6–7 and 110:12 on the official pages; 76:100, 77:9 and 77:14, and 138:45 in local text. The D&C uses “Elias” as a name and as a title (77:14 applies it to John’s mission), so identity is left open. Caution for linking: “Elias” also begins “Elias Higbee” in 113:7.
